messages.subject: Maximum penalized likelihood estimation in unmarked
parts:
Dear unmarked users,

 

I`m trying to draw inferences about the effect of an anthropogenic impact on bird species along three seasons (15 secondary occasions per season). We have a very small number of sites (10 sites with 5 different distances from an anthropogenic impact).

Our predictions were that there would be an increase in rate of extinction in sites more close to the anthropogenic impact. We don`t have any real expectation about the rate of colonization. We also expect occupancy to decrease in sites near the anthropogenic impact as time progress.

For some species everything works perfectly using simple models with colext but for species with low number of detections the occupancy parameters estimates are near the boundaries ( 1 for some sites and 0 for others). I have being reading the studies about the MPLE and I think that the function occuPEN can help me in this situation. Nevertheless, the occuPEN works only for single season models, right? In this case, can I make inferences based on the model selection procedure using colext  and then make occupancy predictions for each season separately using occuPEN? This seems appropriate, somehow?

Thank you very much

Best regards

Marconi Campos
